{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Bitwise

|descr= Encodes array of unique binary flags (zeroes or ones) into a single scalar.
{{Feature | important | Note that the input array is in {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Endianness#Definition|Big Endian}}, meaning that the smallest value is '''to the left'''.}}

|s1= arrayOfNumbers call [[BIS_fnc_encodeFlags2]]

|p1= arrayOfNumbers: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s - "boolean" flags where 0 = false and 1 = true

|r1= [[Number]] - the calculated number

|x1= <sqf>private _result = [1,0,1,1] call BIS_fnc_encodeFlags2;
hint str _result; // Displays 13</sqf>
